invariants.description: with the currents held constant, Vm is exactly linear: Vm = Vm_init - (sum of ionic currents - i_stim) t (currents in A/F = V/s, as Paci 2013 dVm/dt = -(I_ion - I_stim)/Cm)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(Vm - (Vm_init - (i_CaL + i_K1 + i_f + i_Na + i_Kr + i_Ks + i_to + i_PCa + i_NaK + i_NaCa + i_b_Ca + i_b_Na - i_stim)*t))) <= 1e-7

bc_sweep.rationale: each current over +/-10 A/F (covers the hiPSC-CM range apart from the I_Na upstroke peak, whose value does not change the linear-integration check), Vm_init -100 to +50 mV.

baseline.reason: a pure charge integrator; validation belongs to the assembled Paci 2013 cell (action potential against Ma et al. 2011 hiPSC-CM data).

calibrate.note: not_applicable: no free parameters besides the initial value.
